prompt:
You describe a graph or chart from an electronics datasheet for an engineer who cannot see it.

Cover, in this order:
1. What is plotted against what: for each axis, the quantity, the unit and the range (first and last tick labels).
2. Each curve or series: its label or condition (temperature, voltage, mode, ...) and its overall trend in words.
3. Values printed in the figure as text (annotations, labelled points, legend values). Do not estimate values from where a curve sits; if a value is not printed, describe the trend in words instead.

Figure type: graph or chart
Section: 4 Electrical Specifications > 4.1 Current Consumption
Caption: Figure 3: Typical RX Current Consumption over Temperature and Input Power Level, 868/915 MHz, Sensitivity Optimized Setting
Text inside the figure (exact, from the PDF text layer): 16,2 | 16,4 | 16,6 | 16,8 | 17 | 17,2 | 17,4 | 17,6 | 17,8 | -110 -90 -70 -50 -30 -10 | Input Power Level [dBm] | Current [mA] | -40C | +25C | +85C | 1.2 kBaud GFSK | 16,2 | 16,4 | 16,6 | 16,8 | 17,0 | 17,2 | 17,4 | 17,6 | 17,8 | -100 -80 -60 -40 -20 | Input Power Level [dBm] | Current [mA] | -40C | +25C | +85C | 38.4 kBaud GFSK | 16,5 | 17 | 17,5 | 18 | 18,5 | 19 | 19,5 | -100 -80 -60 -40 -20 | Input Power Level [dBm] | Current [mA] | -40C | +25C | +85C | 250 kBaud GFSK | 17,0 | 17,5 | 18,0 | 18,5 | 19,0 | 19,5 | -90 -70 -50 -30 -10 | Input Power Level [dBm] | Current [mA] | -40C | +25C | +85C | 500 kBaud MSK
Text that mentions the figure: none

Rules:
- When a name or number from "Text inside the figure" is visible in the image, copy it exactly, character for character.
- Never invent a value, name, pin, unit or connection. If something is too small or blurry to read, write "unreadable" instead of guessing.
- Describe only what this image shows. Do not explain general theory or add advice.
- Mention each item once. Stop when everything is covered.
- Plain text only: no Markdown headings, tables or bold. Short paragraphs and "- " lists are fine.
- Start directly with what the figure is (for example "Block diagram of ..."), not with "The image shows".

Section: 4 Electrical Specifications > 4.1 Current Consumption
Caption: Figure 3: Typical RX Current Consumption over Temperature and Input Power Level, 868/915 MHz, Sensitivity Optimized Setting

The graphs plot Current [mA] on the vertical axis against Input Power Level [dBm] on the horizontal axis.

For the 1.2 kBaud GFSK graph:
The vertical axis ranges from 16,2 to 17,8.
The horizontal axis ranges from -110 to -10.
The curves are labeled -40C, +25C, and +85C. The trend shows that for all temperatures, the current generally decreases as the input power level increases, with the +85C curve generally showing the lowest current at higher input power levels.
